wargear.name: Sigillite's black seal
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A wax-and-steel writ carrying Malcador's personal authority, which opens any door and closes most arguments. The bearer gains +1 Willpower and +1 Leadership.

wargear.name: Shroud-cloak of the Talons
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cameleoline mantle woven in the Sigillite's own workshops. Enemy units shooting at the bearer from more than 12" suffer -1 to hit, and the bearer gains +1 Initiative.

wargear.name: Seeker's death-mask
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A lacquered faceplate worn by those who hunt oath-breakers, said to still every doubt behind it.

wargear.name: Reliquary of Terran ash
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A sealed flask of ash gathered from the Palace grounds and kept against the heart.

wargear.name: Warding strand
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A braid of silvered wire and prayer-tags knotted across the shoulder guards.

wargear.name: Quarry lens
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. An optic tuned to a single writ-signature, scanning for the one face it has been told to find.

wargear.name: Spite plating
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Plates scavenged from fallen cell-engines, riveted over fresh wounds.

wargear.name: Chaff pods
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Drop-pods of sheared foil and radiating filament, fired to blind pursuing guns.

modifiers.text: Reliquary of Terran ash: Ashes of the Oath.

rules.name: Oath-Bonded
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Garro's Company). A unit with this rule within 12" of Nathaniel Garro or Tylos Rubio automatically passes Morale and Cool Checks.

rules.name: Sealed Orders
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Hunter-Killer Cell). A unit with this rule gains Outflank. On a turn it arrives from Reserves it may Rush and still fire one weapon at its full Ballistic Skill.

rules.name: Unwitnessed
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Unwitnessed Writ). On the first battle turn, enemy units may not target a model with this rule with Shooting Attacks unless it is within 12" of them.

rules.name: Unblinking Mask
rules.text: Legacy house rule. An enemy model in a Challenge with the bearer subtracts 1 from its Focus roll.

rules.name: Ashes of the Oath
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The bearer gains Feel No Pain (6+) and ignores Fear.

rules.name: Strand of Warding
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Enemy Psychic Checks made to target the bearer or its unit suffer -1.

rules.name: Marked Quarry
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once in each of its controlling player's Shooting phases, the first Shooting Attack the unit makes against an enemy unit adds 1 to its Hit Tests.

rules.name: Plated in Spite
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The model gains a 5+ Save if it was worse. A model with this rule slain in combat inflicts one automatic Hit (S4, AP -) on the unit that slew it.

rules.name: Chaff Veil
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The first Shooting Attack made against the unit each battle suffers -1 to Hit.

armyRules.name: Hounded by Fate
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The two Knights-Errant march with the weight of what they have seen. Nathaniel Garro and Tylos Rubio add 1 to their Cool, but may only be joined to Automata units from this army and are never counted as part of a Legion for any other friendly rule.

armyRules.name: Cold Hunters
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. The Mechanicum automata of the cell are built for a single purpose, and have no patience for anything else. Automata add 1 to their Ballistic Skill and subtract 1 from their Willpower. They cannot hold or contest objectives unless Nathaniel Garro or Tylos Rubio is within 12".

rites.name: Garro's Company
rites.flavor: A handful of oath-breakers and loyalists, bound by the one thing neither side believed in.
benefits: Castellax Battle, Castellax Destructor and Domitar Battle Maniples may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
Maniples gain Oath-Bonded: while within 12" of Garro or Rubio they automatically pass Morale and Cool Checks.
limitations: Garro or Rubio must be in the army.
No Vorax Attack Maniples or Vultarax Stratos Squadrons.

rites.name: The Hunter-Killer Cell
rites.flavor: Four fast engines, one sealed order, and nobody to ask what it said.
benefits: Vorax Attack Maniples and Vultarax Stratos Squadrons may fill Troops slots and gain Line (1).
They gain Sealed Orders: Outflank, and on a turn it arrives from Reserves a unit may Rush and still fire one weapon.
limitations: At least one Vorax Attack Maniple is required.
Every Vorax and Vultarax must start the battle in Reserve.
No Thanatar Siege, Domitar Battle or Castellax Destructor Maniples.

modifiers.text: The Hunter-Killer Cell: Line (1), Sealed Orders.

rites.name: The Unwitnessed Writ
rites.flavor: Some orders are carried out in silence, by engines that cannot be questioned and cannot talk.
benefits: Thanatar Siege Maniples may fill Elites slots.
Thanatar and Domitar Maniples gain Infiltrate (9) and Unwitnessed: on the first battle turn the enemy can't pick them as a target for Shooting Attacks unless within 12".
limitations: At least one Thanatar Siege Maniple is required.
No Vorax Attack Maniples or Vultarax Stratos Squadrons.

require.note: The writ needs a Thanatar to carry it out.
